snippet.title: Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor - After Hours DLC Trailer
snippet.description:
What do the dwarves get up to in their time off, besides hanging out at the Abyss Bar, of course? The After Hours pack will give you an exclusive peek at the secret lives of the dwarves.

This DLC includes the following:

- The ‘Slayer’ skin for the Scout
- The ‘Fanboy’ skin for the Driller
- The ‘Scientist’ skin for the Engineer
- The ‘King’ skin for the Gunner

Check it out here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3818560/Deep_Rock_Galactic_Survivor__After_Hours_Pack/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=description&utm_campaign=dlc_trailer

NOTE: This DLC is cosmetic only. It won’t affect your performance in the game, unless you consider “drilling with large foam fingers” performance-enhancing (which would be fair).

Developed by Funday Games
Published by Ghost Ship Publishing

Find out more:
https://www.fundaygames.dk/drgs
